examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تعريف نوع بيانات مجردة باستخدام CLOS مع تغليف البيانات والطرق.
examples.descEn: Learn to define an abstract data type using CLOS with data encapsulation and methods.
examples.code:
(defclass bank-account ()
  ((balance :initarg :balance :initform 0 :accessor account-balance)))

(defmethod deposit ((acc bank-account) amount)
  "إيداع مبلغ في الحساب"
  (incf (account-balance acc) amount))

(defmethod withdraw ((acc bank-account) amount)
  "سحب مبلغ إذا كان الرصيد كافيًا"
  (when (>= (account-balance acc) amount)
    (decf (account-balance acc) amount)
    t))

(let ((acc (make-instance 'bank-account :balance 100)))
  (deposit acc 50)
  (format t "Balance after deposit: ~D~%" (account-balance acc))
  (format t "Withdraw 30: ~A~%" (withdraw acc 30))
  (format t "Balance after withdrawal: ~D~%" (account-balance acc)))
examples.expectedStdout:
Balance after deposit: 150
Withdraw 30: T
Balance after withdrawal: 120

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تمثيل الرسم البياني كقائمة تجاور وتنفيذ البحث العرضي.
examples.descEn: Learn to represent a graph as an adjacency list and perform BFS.
examples.code:
(defun bfs (graph start)
  "بحث عرضي: يزور العقد طبقة بطبقة"
  (let ((visited (make-hash-table))
        (queue (list start))
        (order '()))
    (setf (gethash start visited) t)
    (loop while queue
          do (let ((node (pop queue)))
               (push node order)
               (dolist (neighbor (gethash node graph))
                 (unless (gethash neighbor visited)
                   (setf (gethash neighbor visited) t)
                   (setf queue (append queue (list neighbor)))))))
    (nreverse order)))

(let ((graph (make-hash-table)))
  (setf (gethash 0 graph) '(1 2))
  (setf (gethash 1 graph) '(0 3 4))
  (setf (gethash 2 graph) '(0 5))
  (setf (gethash 3 graph) '(1))
  (setf (gethash 4 graph) '(1 5))
  (setf (gethash 5 graph) '(2 4))
  (format t "~a~%" (bfs graph 0)))

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب تنفيذ كومة دنيا (Min Heap) باستخدام مصفوفة مع عمليات الإدراج والاستخراج.
examples.descEn: Learn to implement a min heap using an array with insert and extract-min operations.
examples.code:
(defun heap-insert (heap item)
  "أضف عنصرًا إلى الكومة ثم أعد الترتيب لأعلى"
  (vector-push-extend item heap)
  (let ((i (1- (length heap))))
    (loop while (and (> i 0)
                     (< (aref heap i) (aref heap (floor (1- i) 2))))
          do (rotatef (aref heap i) (aref heap (floor (1- i) 2)))
             (setf i (floor (1- i) 2))))
  heap)

(defun heap-extract-min (heap)
  "أزل وأرجع أصغر عنصر ثم أعد الترتيب لأسفل"
  (when (> (length heap) 1)
    (let ((min (aref heap 0)))
      (setf (aref heap 0) (aref heap (1- (length heap))))
      (vector-pop heap)
      (let ((i 0))
        (loop while (< i (length heap))
              do (let ((left (1+ (* 2 i)))
                       (right (+ 2 (* 2 i)))
                       (smallest i))
                   (when (and (< left (length heap))
                              (< (aref heap left) (aref heap smallest)))
                     (setf smallest left))
                   (when (and (< right (length heap))
                              (< (aref heap right) (aref heap smallest)))
                     (setf smallest right))
                   (if (/= smallest i)
                       (progn (rotatef (aref heap i) (aref heap smallest))
                              (setf i smallest))
                       (return)))))
      min)))

(let ((heap (make-array 0 :fill-pointer 0 :adjustable t)))
  (heap-insert heap 30)
  (heap-insert heap 10)
  (heap-insert heap 20)
  (heap-insert heap 5)
  (format t "Min: ~D~%" (heap-extract-min heap))
  (format t "Min: ~D~%" (heap-extract-min heap))
  (format t "Min: ~D~%" (heap-extract-min heap)))

examples.titleEn: Binary Search in a Sorted Array
examples.descAr: تتعلّم كيفية تنفيذ البحث الثنائي في مصفوفة مرتبة باستخدام التكرار.
examples.descEn: Learn how to implement binary search on a sorted array using recursion.
examples.code:
(defun binary-search (arr target &optional (low 0) (high (1- (length arr))))
  ;; حالة الإيقاف: لم يبقَ نطاق للبحث
  (if (> low high)
      -1
      (let ((mid (floor (+ low high) 2)))
        (cond
          ((= (aref arr mid) target) mid)
          ((< (aref arr mid) target) (binary-search arr target (1+ mid) high))
          (t (binary-search arr target low (1- mid)))))))

(defparameter *sorted-array* #(1 3 5 7 9 11 13))
(format t "Index of 7: ~a~%" (binary-search *sorted-array* 7))
(format t "Index of 4: ~a~%" (binary-search *sorted-array* 4))

examples.descAr: تتعلّم بناء شجرة بحث ثنائية وإجراء اجتياز بالترتيب (in-order) لإخراج العناصر مرتبة.
examples.descEn: Learn to build a binary search tree and perform in-order traversal to output sorted elements.
examples.code:
(defstruct bst-node
  (key nil)
  (left nil)
  (right nil))

(defun bst-insert (node key)
  (cond
    ((null node) (make-bst-node :key key))
    ((< key (bst-node-key node))
     (setf (bst-node-left node) (bst-insert (bst-node-left node) key))
     node)
    ((> key (bst-node-key node))
     (setf (bst-node-right node) (bst-insert (bst-node-right node) key))
     node)
    (t node)))

(defun bst-inorder (node)
  (when node
    (bst-inorder (bst-node-left node))
    (format t "~a " (bst-node-key node))
    (bst-inorder (bst-node-right node))))

(let ((root nil))
  (dolist (k '(50 30 70 20 40 60 80))
    (setf root (bst-insert root k)))
  (bst-inorder root)
  (format t "~%"))

examples.descAr: يتعلّم الطالب استخدام logand للتحقق من زوجية عددٍ بفحص البتّ الأخير.
examples.descEn: Learn to check parity using logand to test the least significant bit.
examples.code:
(defun evenp-bit (n)
  ;; logand مع 1 يعيد 0 للأعداد الزوجية و1 للفردية
  (zerop (logand n 1)))

(dolist (num '(0 1 2 3 4 5))
  (format t "~a is ~a~%" num (if (evenp-bit num) "even" "odd")))

0 is even
1 is odd
2 is even
3 is odd
4 is even
5 is odd

examples.descAr: يطبق الطالب الفرز الفقاعي ويحسب عدد التبديلات لفهم تعقيد الخوارزمية.
examples.descEn: Implement bubble sort and count swaps to understand the algorithm's complexity.
examples.code:
(defun bubble-sort (lst)
  "فرز فقاعي: يكرر المقارنات ويبدل المتجاورين حتى يستقر"
  (let ((arr (copy-seq lst))
        (n (length lst))
        (swaps 0))
    (dotimes (i (1- n))
      (dotimes (j (- n i 1))
        (when (> (aref arr j) (aref arr (1+ j)))
          (rotatef (aref arr j) (aref arr (1+ j)))
          (incf swaps))))
    (values arr swaps)))

(multiple-value-bind (sorted swaps) (bubble-sort #(5 1 4 2 8))
  (format t "~a~%" sorted)
  (format t "Swaps: ~a~%" swaps))

examples.descAr: يتعلّم الطالبُ تحويلَ الأحرف باستخدام دوالّ رموز الأحرف (char-code) و (code-char) مع التعامل مع الالتفاف.
examples.descEn: Learn to shift characters using char-code and code-char with wrap-around handling.
examples.code:
(defun caesar (str shift)
  "يشفّر النص بإزاحة الأحرف الأبجدية"
  (map 'string
       (lambda (c)
         (if (alpha-char-p c)
             (let* ((base (if (upper-case-p c) 65 97))
                    (offset (- (char-code c) base)))
               (code-char (+ base (mod (+ offset shift) 26))))
             c))
       str))

(format t "~a~%" (caesar "Hello, World!" 3))
(format t "~a~%" (caesar "Khoor, Zruog!" -3))

examples.descEn: Learn to create a wrapper that adds behavior (logging) to an existing function.
examples.code:
(defun log-wrapper (fn)
  (lambda (&rest args)
    (format t "Calling with ~a~%" args)
    (apply fn args)))

(setf add (lambda (a b) (+ a b)))
(setf logged-add (log-wrapper add))
(format t "Result: ~d~%" (funcall logged-add 3 4))

examples.descAr: تتعلّم استخدام البرمجة الديناميكية لتجنّب الحساب المتكرر في تسلسل فيبوناتشي.
examples.descEn: Learn to use dynamic programming to avoid redundant computation in the Fibonacci sequence.
examples.code:
(defun fib-dp (n)
  ;; جدول لحفظ النتائج المحسوبة مسبقاً
  (let ((memo (make-array (max 2 (1+ n)) :initial-element -1)))
    (setf (aref memo 0) 0)
    (setf (aref memo 1) 1)
    (labels ((fib-helper (k)
               ;; إذا كانت القيمة غير محسوبة، نحسبها ونخزنها
               (if (= (aref memo k) -1)
                   (setf (aref memo k) (+ (fib-helper (1- k)) (fib-helper (- k 2))))
                   (aref memo k))))
      (fib-helper n))))

(format t "F(10) = ~a~%" (fib-dp 10))
(format t "F(20) = ~a~%" (fib-dp 20))

examples.descAr: يطبق الطالب خوارزمية إقليدس بطريقة تكرارية ويطبع خطوات الحساب.
examples.descEn: Implement Euclid's algorithm iteratively and print the steps.
examples.code:
(defun gcd-steps (a b)
  "حساب القاسم المشترك الأكبر مع عرض الخطوات"
  (loop while (not (zerop b))
        do (format t "~a ~a~%" a b)
           (psetq a b
                  b (mod a b)))
  a)

(format t "GCD = ~a~%" (gcd-steps 48 18))

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب استخدام التعبيرات الحسابية والمنطقية وجمل التعيين مع setf في Common Lisp.
examples.descEn: Learn to use arithmetic and logical expressions and assignment statements with setf in Common Lisp.
examples.code:
(let ((x 10) (y 3))
  (setf x (+ x y))          ; تعيين: x = x + y
  (setf y (* x 2))          ; تعيين: y = x * 2
  (format t "x=~D y=~D~%" x y)
  (format t "(~D > ~D) = ~A~%" x y (> x y))
  (format t "(~D AND ~D) = ~A~%" x y (and (> x 0) (> y 0))))

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب حساب المضروب بطريقة تكرارية باستخدام حلقة.
examples.descEn: Learn to compute factorial iteratively using a loop.
examples.code:
(defun factorial (n)
  (loop for i from 1 to n
        for result = 1 then (* result i)
        finally (return result)))

(format t "~a~%" (factorial 10))

examples.descAr: يتعلّم الطالبُ بناءَ قائمةٍ بأمر loop وطباعتَها بسطرٍ واحد، مع شرطٍ مركّبٍ يسبق شرطي القسمة.
examples.descEn: Learn to build a list with a loop and print it in one line, with a combined condition before the divisibility checks.
examples.code:
(format t "~{~A~%~}"
        (loop for i from 1 to 15
              collect (cond ((zerop (mod i 15)) "FizzBuzz")
                            ((zerop (mod i 3)) "Fizz")
                            ((zerop (mod i 5)) "Buzz")
                            (t i))))

2
Fizz

    (setf (gethash node visited) t)
    (format t "~D " node)

      (dfs neighbor visited))))

(defun insertion-sort (arr)
  "فرز بالإدراج: يبني المصفوفة المرتبة تدريجياً"
  (let ((a (copy-seq arr)))
    (loop for i from 1 below (length a)
          do (let ((key (aref a i))
                   (j (1- i)))
               (loop while (and (>= j 0) (> (aref a j) key))
                     do (setf (aref a (1+ j)) (aref a j))
                        (decf j))
               (setf (aref a (1+ j)) key))
          do (format t "~a~%" a))
    a))

(defun matrix-multiply (a b)
  "ضرب مصفوفتين a و b (أبعاد مناسبة)"
  (let* ((rows (array-dimension a 0))
         (cols (array-dimension b 1))
         (inner (array-dimension a 1))
         (result (make-array (list rows cols) :initial-element 0)))
    (dotimes (i rows)
      (dotimes (j cols)
        (dotimes (k inner)
          (incf (aref result i j) (* (aref a i k) (aref b k j))))))
    result))

(defun print-matrix (m)
  "طباعة المصفوفة سطراً بسطر"
  (dotimes (i (array-dimension m 0))
    (dotimes (j (array-dimension m 1))
      (format t "~a " (aref m i j)))
    (format t "~%")))

(let ((a (make-array '(2 3) :initial-contents '((1 2 3) (4 5 6))))
      (b (make-array '(3 2) :initial-contents '((7 8) (9 10) (11 12)))))
  (print-matrix (matrix-multiply a b)))

(defun mean (xs)
  (/ (reduce #'+ xs) (length xs)))

(defun median (xs)
  (let ((s (sort (copy-list xs) #'<)))
    (if (oddp (length s))
        (nth (floor (length s) 2) s)
        (/ (+ (nth (1- (floor (length s) 2)) s)
              (nth (floor (length s) 2) s)) 2))))

(defun std-dev (xs)
  (let ((m (mean xs)))
    (sqrt (/ (reduce #'+ (mapcar (lambda (x) (expt (- x m) 2)) xs))
             (length xs)))))

(let ((data '(10 20 30 40 50)))
  (format t "Mean: ~a~%" (mean data))
  (format t "Median: ~a~%" (median data))
  (format t "StdDev: ~a~%" (std-dev data)))

examples.descEn: Learn to use memoization to speed up repeated recursive computations.
examples.code:
(defun fib (n)
  (let ((cache (make-hash-table)))
    (labels ((fib-aux (k)
               (or (gethash k cache)
                   (setf (gethash k cache)
                         (if (< k 2) k
                             (+ (fib-aux (- k 1)) (fib-aux (- k 2))))))))
      (fib-aux n))))

(defun merge-lists (l1 l2)
  "دمج قائمتين مرتبتين"
  (cond ((null l1) l2)
        ((null l2) l1)
        ((<= (car l1) (car l2))
         (cons (car l1) (merge-lists (cdr l1) l2)))
        (t (cons (car l2) (merge-lists l1 (cdr l2))))))

(defun merge-sort (lst)
  "فرز بالدمج: يقسم القائمة ثم يدمج النصفين المرتبين"
  (if (or (null lst) (null (cdr lst)))
      lst
      (let* ((mid (floor (length lst) 2))
             (left (subseq lst 0 mid))
             (right (subseq lst mid)))
        (merge-lists (merge-sort left) (merge-sort right)))))

(format t "~a~%" (merge-sort '(38 27 43 3 9 82 10)))

(defun prime-factors (n)
  "إرجاع قائمة بالعوامل الأولية للعدد n"
  (let ((factors nil)
        (d 2))
    (loop while (> n 1) do
      (loop while (= (mod n d) 0) do
        (push d factors)
        (setf n (/ n d)))
      (incf d))
    (nreverse factors)))

examples.descEn: Learn to generate primes up to a limit using the Sieve of Eratosthenes.

(defun sieve (n)
  (let ((primes (make-array (1+ n) :initial-element t)))
    (setf (aref primes 0) nil
          (aref primes 1) nil)
    (loop for i from 2 to (isqrt n)
          when (aref primes i)
          do (loop for j from (* i i) to n by i
                   do (setf (aref primes j) nil)))
    (loop for i from 2 to n
          when (aref primes i)
          collect i)))

(format t "~{~a~^ ~}~%" (sieve 30))

examples.descAr: يتعلم الطالب بناء طابور (FIFO) باستخدام قائمة مرتبطة في Common Lisp مع عمليات الإضافة والحذف.
examples.descEn: Learn to implement a FIFO queue using a linked list in Common Lisp with enqueue and dequeue operations.
examples.code:
(defstruct (queue (:constructor make-queue)) (front nil) (back nil))

(defun enqueue (q item)
  "أضف عنصرًا إلى نهاية الطابور"
  (let ((new-node (cons item nil)))
    (if (queue-front q)
        (setf (cdr (queue-back q)) new-node)
        (setf (queue-front q) new-node))
    (setf (queue-back q) new-node)
    q))

(defun dequeue (q)
  "أزل وأرجع العنصر من مقدمة الطابور"
  (when (queue-front q)
    (let ((item (car (queue-front q))))
      (setf (queue-front q) (cdr (queue-front q)))
      (unless (queue-front q) (setf (queue-back q) nil))
      item)))

(let ((q (make-queue)))
  (enqueue q 10)
  (enqueue q 20)
  (enqueue q 30)
  (format t "Dequeue: ~D~%" (dequeue q))
  (format t "Dequeue: ~D~%" (dequeue q))
  (enqueue q 40)
  (format t "Dequeue: ~D~%" (dequeue q))
  (format t "Dequeue: ~D~%" (dequeue q)))

examples.descEn: Learn to build a stack using a linked list with push, pop, and peek operations.
examples.code:
(defstruct stack-node
  (value nil)
  (next nil))

(defstruct stack
  (top nil))

(defun push-stack (stk val)
  (setf (stack-top stk)
        (make-stack-node :value val :next (stack-top stk))))

(defun pop-stack (stk)
  (let ((node (stack-top stk)))
    (when node
      (setf (stack-top stk) (stack-node-next node))
      (stack-node-value node))))

(defun peek-stack (stk)
  (when (stack-top stk)
    (stack-node-value (stack-top stk))))

(let ((s (make-stack)))
  (push-stack s 10)
  (push-stack s 20)
  (push-stack s 30)
  (format t "Top: ~a~%" (peek-stack s))
  (format t "Pop: ~a~%" (pop-stack s))
  (format t "Pop: ~a~%" (pop-stack s))
  (format t "Top after pops: ~a~%" (peek-stack s)))

Pop: 30
Pop: 20
Top after pops: 10

examples.descEn: Learn to use a while loop with counter and accumulator variables to compute the sum of numbers from 1 to 10.
examples.code:
(defparameter sum 0)
(defparameter i 1)
(loop while (<= i 10) do
  (setf sum (+ sum i))
  (setf i (1+ i)))
(format t "Sum = ~D~%" sum)
